title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy of a 365 Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Bardon Trimount Corporation d/b/a Aggregate Industries (Watertown).
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure, pursuant to G.L. c. 25, § 5(d). Commissioners participating were: Paul B. Vasington, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, James Connelly, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deidre K. Manning.
